item.title: Service wins 157-pound title, becomes Harwood’s first state champion since 2013
item.description: Nicky Service made history for Harwood Union High School on Saturday night. Advertisement ----------------------------------- The senior captured the 157-pound title at the Vermont State Wrestling Championships at Champlain Valley Union High School, defeating Mason Atkins of Mount Abraham 9-7 in the championship final. item.title: Vermont Ski & Snowboard Hall of Fame celebrates 2025 and 2026 nominees
item.description: The Vermont Ski and Snowboard Museum hosts the Vermont Ski & Snowboard Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony and reception on May 30, 2026, at the K-1 Lodge at Killington Resort. Warren resident and former Sugarbush owner Win Smith is one of the nominees, as is the late Gary Black Jr., Waitsfield. item.title: HUUSD budget passes, LOT passes, Path Association position funded
item.description: By a vote of 362-168 Waitsfield voters approved the town-wide adoption of a Local Option Tax that adds 1% tax to rooms, meals, alcohol and retail and online sales. In a full year it will generate about $600,000. This year it will go into effect in July and generate an estimated $450,000. Advertisement ----------------------------------- Voters in Warren and Waitsfield approved $15,150 per town to help fund an implementation path coordinator for the Mad River Path’s Active Transportation corridor

item.title: Warren Select Board, Habitat for Humanity to discuss town garage site
item.description: The Warren Planning Commission hopes to partner with Habitat for Humanity on a feasibility study to develop housing on the town’s former town garage site on School Road. To that end the commissioners drafted proposed conditions for the select board to discuss with Habitat at an April 28 meeting.
